title: Rainy Day in Sioux Falls
subtitle: Everything on this list is indoors, so weather is never a reason to stay home.

stops.note: Science, art, and an IMAX-style theater under one roof — easily 3 to 4 hours.
Lunch and pastries from an award-winning pastry chef, ranked #1 on Tripadvisor locally.
A free guided tour of an 1889 Queen Anne home, a genuine hidden gem.
An escape room or axe throwing session, entirely indoors.
An elevated comfort-food dinner to close out the day.

seo.title: Rainy Day in Sioux Falls: Indoor Things to Do
seo.description: A full day of indoor Sioux Falls activities for a rainy or snowy day — museums, an escape room, and real local dining.
